user.title: Connect your Neptune Apex
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Apex controller on your local network (for example 192.168.1.50 or apex.local). No login is needed for monitoring.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach an Apex controller at that address. Double check it's powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Apex controller is already set up.
